title: PCB Board Plate Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter required parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required parameters for the protocol as prompted.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App.

steps.title: Transfer buffer to PCB wells
steps.instruction: Using a P20 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, transfer buffer to the PCB wells, pause for 1 minute, and repeat the transfer for each well.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate buffer with P20 GEN2 pipette
Dispense buffer into target PCB well

steps.title: Start protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
